name: Oregon Humane Youth Volunteers (Portland campus)
what_you_do: Youth volunteers walk dogs and play with them. They also play with cats and small animals and help keep the shelter clean and healthy.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 12 to 17 at the Portland campus. People who qualify go into a random lottery for limited spots.
duration: One 2-hour shift every other week for at least 6 months (Wed to Sun 4 to 6 pm, plus weekend 10 am to noon)
deadline_text: Next application window opens 11 am November 30 and closes 6 pm December 4. The page does not print the year. Windows typically open in December and again in June.
how_to_apply: Send in the youth form during an application window. A lottery picks the spots.
notes: Confirm the window dates on the page, since the year is not printed. The page says applications for the Portland campus are closed now.
